states._comment: Owner rule (Nov 11 2026): no state that needs a broker registration, license or fee. From compliance/state_broker_rules.md section 6. Every lead file is filtered to 'usable' and never includes 'excluded'. product_overrides limits what we pitch in a state.

product_overrides.TX: working capital / contract financing only, NO MCA (Texas sales-based financing needs OCCC registration)
product_overrides.NC: MCA / factoring / PO financing, NO loans (NC Loan Broker Act filing)
